method: Original index connectivity; no welding or reorientation; cross norm <=1e-18 m^2 degenerate. acos(n1 dot n2) is 0 smooth and 180 opposed; signed atan2(edge1 dot cross(n1,n2), n1 dot n2), edge1 from triangle1. Sign depends on orientation and triangle order, not a universal convexity convention. No intersection or clearance test performed.
